LESSON: ORAL PRESENTATIONS

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 2
Topic 10.1.1: Oral Presentations

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Oral Presentations. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How can one improve the presentation of a song to make it interesting?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify features of songs in the locality
2. use performance techniques when singing
3. write songs on a scientific innovation
4. appreciate the role of songs in the society

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: ORAL PRESENTATIONS
This lesson teaches Oral Presentations for Grade 8 ENGLISH.

STUDY STEPS
1. identify features of songs in the locality
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. use performance techniques when singing
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. write songs on a scientific innovation
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
4. appreciate the role of songs in the society
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Oral Presentations using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Oral Presentations above.
2. Explain Oral Presentations to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Oral Presentations.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Oral Presentations with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Oral Presentations important for a Grade 8 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How can one improve the presentation of a song to make it interesting?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify features of songs in the locality
2. use performance techniques when singing
3. write songs on a scientific innovation
4. appreciate the role of songs in the society

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
